title: Chicken Alfredo Fettuccine
author: farag4m

step.title: Season chicken
step.text: Season both sides with salt, black pepper, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, and Italian seasoning. Let rest for about 10 minutes.

step.title: Saute onion and garlic
step.text: Using Saute mode, cook the diced onion in butter or oil for 4–5 minutes until softened. Add minced garlic and cook for another 30–60 seconds.

ingredients.text: Rao's Homemade Roasted Garlic Alfredo Sauce

step.title: Make Alfredo sauce
step.text: Add the Alfredo sauce to the onion and garlic. Heat on low Saute for about 3 minutes, stirring frequently.

step.title: Prepare fettuccine
step.text: Break the fettuccine in half and arrange it loosely in crisscross layers in the pressure cooker. Add enough clean water to cover it by about 1/2 inch and add about 1 tsp salt.

step.title: Pressure cook chicken
step.text: Add 1 cup water and the seasoned chicken to the pressure cooker. Pressure cook on High for 10–15 minutes. Natural release for 5 minutes, then release the remaining pressure. Remove the chicken and reserve the broth.

step.title: Brown chicken
step.text: Empty the pressure cooker, switch to Saute, and add butter or oil. Brown the chicken for about 3–4 minutes per side, then remove it.

step.title: Coat chicken in Alfredo
step.text: Add the browned chicken to the Alfredo sauce and warm for 2–3 minutes, coating it well. Transfer the chicken and sauce to a covered container and set aside.

step.title: Cook fettuccine
step.text: Pressure cook the prepared fettuccine on High for 4 minutes, then immediately quick release. If slightly firm, let it sit in the hot water for 1–2 minutes, then drain.

step.title: Combine
step.text: Return the drained fettuccine to the pressure cooker. Add the Alfredo sauce and toss gently until coated, then add the chicken. If the sauce is too thick, add a small splash of reserved chicken broth or water.

notes: Pressure-cooker-only recipe. Chicken breasts are preferred. Use the pressure cooker's Saute mode for browning the chicken and cooking the onion, garlic, and Alfredo sauce.
